LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: MCUDP/LA/MUT (W-14) 14/02/S. Land Ministry Ref No.: 4/3/10/2014/LRB/337. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the servitude of the lands described below for the construction of a tunnel to create a drainage way from the main canal in Aluth Mawatha area up to the sea under a sub project of Metro Colombo Urban Development Project. Description of the land to be acquired: Thirty one (31) allotments of lands described in following names and extents and total extent of 0.4919 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 01 to 30 and 33 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9653 dated 18.08.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village called Muthuwal in the Grama Niladhari Division of Lunu Pokuna, Aluth Mawatha in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Colombo in Colombo District of the Western Province and morefully described as follows:— 01. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/Servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 25th October, 2016 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th October, 2016, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.
